_comment: Art Avenue — example product records (the data model in action). Each shows the aa.* metafields a merchant sets. Anything not set is inherited from the preset. These map 1:1 to the prototype's demo SKUs. Import via Admin API productUpdate.metafields or matrixify/CSV.
